extra.summary: Two flat AK70s (x axis) at y -/+70 drive a miter-bevel differential (side-gear axis = lateral y through P, cross shaft along x); cage rotation phi = forward swing, cross-shaft spin psi = lateral tilt of the arm; S3 XM540 along the arm.

axes.u_phi: lateral y through P (motors A+B common mode), cage rotation, ~baseline S2 role
axes.p_psi: cross shaft, x at phi=0, rotates with the cage (motors A-B differential), arm tilt toward +y
axes.S3: XM540 along the arm axis, 70..114 mm from P
axes.motors: AK70-10 A at y=-70 and B at y=+70, axes along x, back faces at x=-104 on a 6 mm PA-CF saddle (x -110..-104)

extra.kinematics: d = (cos psi sin phi, sin psi, cos psi cos phi), phi = -s (s forward positive).  Gear angles alpha (A), beta (B) about +y: phi=(alpha+beta)/2, psi=(alpha-beta)/2 * Zg/Zp (=1, miter Z30/Z30).  Motor angles theta_A = sigma_A alpha, theta_B = sigma_B beta (k_in = 1; sign pattern sigma = +/-1 set at bench).  Torques: T_phi = tau_A+tau_B, T_psi = (Zp/Zg)(tau_A-tau_B); each motor tau = (T_phi +/- T_psi)/2.
extra.unreachable: baseline directions with lateral latitude asin(d_y) > 50 deg (arm raised sideways, S2 > ~60 at S1 ~ 90) and < -15 deg (back-medial, S2 < ~-12): 20.1 % of the baseline set; psi range is capped by the sector-gear window (pinion mesh arc + boom window must not overlap: delta psi < ~65 deg for a 14 mm boom starting 70 mm from P, tube R32 beyond the gear radius)
extra.head_neck_note: closest part to skin: motor A 42.5 mm (head/neck 60 mm rule not met statically at P_z = 0; drop P_z by ~20-30 mm or narrow)
extra.P_vs_back: P at x = -23.25 (85 mm behind the back surface x -108... i.e. 85 mm), baseline 108 mm: P moves -23.25 mm toward the body; z and y unchanged (P_z 0, y 0)

torque.note: tau_motor = (|T_phi|+|T_psi|)/2 with k_in = 1; baseline S2 alone 6.49 N.m on one motor (SF 1.28). Single-axis peak: 2 x 8.3 = 16.6 N.m on either axis if the other is unloaded. SF>=2 needs tau <= 4.15 N.m: unbalanced worst case inside the soft range passes (see SF); a phi balancer (zero-length spring, K ~3.8 N.m) fixes it; an option is k_in = 2 (motor pinion Z20 : gear Z40) halving motor torque (and speed range) at +gear size.
torque.efficiency: two bevel meshes in series per path (0.97 each, assumed) = 0.94

gears.cross_pinions: Z30 miter, 2 on a 10 mm shaft
gears.vendor: PLACEHOLDER: hardened steel bevel gears (e.g. KHK-class SB1.5-30), none selected; bearing sizes PLACEHOLDER

backlash.note: AK70 internal planetary backlash not included (unverified)

extra.stops: passive, 5 deg beyond soft: phi (cage) by TPU-bumped lug on the cage plate vs two posts on the saddle housing; psi by the hub boom hitting TPU bumpers on the cage plates at psi hard -15 / +55.  Stops sit at the OUTPUT, so they load the housing/cage and never the gear train.  Because motor angles couple both axes, the motor-side travel limit is the L-infinity box in (phi,psi); the firmware must clamp (phi,psi), not motor angles.
extra.balancer: a zero-length spring/cord on the cage about the lateral axis (u), mounted on the saddle above/behind motor A; it cancels T_phi only; the psi component of the arm weight (|T_psi|<= G sin(psi) cos(.)) stays on the motors.
extra.wiring: 8.2 mm bundle: motors' CAN/power stay on the fixed saddle (no wire crosses a joint for the motors); the XM540 + elbow/hand wires cross the differential: route as a service loop through the hollow cross shaft (bore 10 mm needed, shaft shown solid: PLACEHOLDER) then along the boom; limited by psi/phi travel (clockspring not needed for +/-90).
extra.decision_conflicts: Overrides (per Forest, this study only): ball-styled shoulder and axes concurrent at P (they remain concurrent, but the S1/S2 roles are replaced by phi/psi; 'S1 vertical' no longer exists).  Keeps: 3 DOF + same actuators, passive stops, 5 deg margin, no backplate/hip belt.  Head/neck keep-out: medial motor B/A at y -115..-26 is at head height (P_z = 0); static skin gap reported - needs the 60 mm head/neck rule checked.
extra.contract_changes: S1 base block/plate 4xM5 pattern, keel/crown/spaulder, yoke, S2 clamp, balancer anchors, S1 stop posts and lug all retire; new 6 mm saddle (2 x motor pad) bolts to the wing tongue; wing tongue seat height/width must widen to y -116..+116.  ROM/keep-out tables, control homology map (S1/S2 -> phi/psi, differential decoupling) and firmware gravity model change.
pros: max single-axis torque 16.6 N.m (SF 2.6 alone vs 1.28 today)
all heavy motors fixed on the wing (no motor mass on the moving arm base; low inertia at S1/S2)
no cables cross the first two joints for the motors
cons: both motors work on every move (differential); unbalanced SF 2.57 inside the range but 1.81 if gravity splits 45/45 between phi and psi (outside this range): balancer still advisable
psi range capped at 65 deg span (window): 20 % of baseline directions unreachable
gear train 8 steel bevel gears, backlash 14-20 arcmin ~ 2.4 mm at tip, noise, cost
230 mm wide (y -115..+115) at head height: neck/head clearance and shoulder-lateral overhang
pinion/cage loads and sector-gear windows are fragile
risks: sector-gear window geometry not proven (proxy only)
gear tooth stress with 16.6 N.m peaks (not calculated)
controls: coupling + singularity at psi = +/-90 (outside range)
gates_to_rerun: full sweep + keep-out tables (keepout_map, sweep_full, gen_tables)
S2 free-fall braking (T12) both motors, dual windings
assumptions: miter gears Z30 module 1.5, 10 arcmin/mesh, 0.97 efficiency
arm weight moment G = 6.46 N.m worst (payload 0.5 kg at the claw tip)
AK70 length 50.25 and radius 44.5 (verified), flange pattern PLACEHOLDER
gear blanks modelled as stacked cylinders; mass = volume x 7.85 x 0.6
